description: Historical experiment with prescribed tropospheric and stratospheric ozone concentration changes throughout the atmospheric column and other forcings held at pre-industrial levels.  For 1850-2021 use CMIP7 historical O3 and for 2022-2023 use the Medium scenario O3.
branch_information: Initialize from an equilibrated pre-industrial control state at a model-specific branch time; use independent initial conditions for ensemble members.
